parameters.name: EndOfJobCreatedTimeRange
parameters.description:
The end of the job creation time range.

- The date format must follow the ISO 8601 standard and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

- The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: MaximumPageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page of a paged query.

- Valid values: **\[1, 300]**.

- Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next page. It is a 32-bit universally unique identifier (UUID).

- If the query result is truncated, the NextPageToken parameter is returned. The value of this parameter is updated for each query. Use this token in the next query to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: PipelineId
parameters.description:
The ID of the MPS queue. For more information, see [Terms](~~29197~~).

- You can view and create MPS queues in the [MPS console](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing **Global Settings** > **Pipelines**.

- If you want to receive asynchronous notification messages, attach an MNS queue or topic to the MPS queue. For more information, see <props="china">[Receive message notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[Receive message notifications](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>.

parameters.name: SnapshotJobIds
parameters.description:
The list of snapshot job IDs.

- You can query up to **10** jobs at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

- You can obtain the job IDs from the [MPS console](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing **Task Management** > **Snapshots**. You can also obtain them from the response parameters of the [SubmitSnapshotJob](~~602857~~) operation.

parameters.name: StartOfJobCreatedTimeRange
parameters.description:
The beginning of the job creation time range.

- The date format must follow the ISO 8601 standard and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

- The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the snapshot jobs to query.

- **Submitted**: The job is submitted.

- **Snapshoting**: The job is in progress.

- **Success**: The job is successful.

- **Fail**: The job failed.
